item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Enables DSPy memory cache with `configure_cache(...)` and uses `dspy.LM(..., cache=True)`, which exercises the cached LM path described in the evidence."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `litellm.completion` and the fake inspects `api_base`/`api_key`, returning endpoint-specific text via `FakeResp`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Makes two LM calls with the same prompt and changes only `api_base` and `api_key`, matching the ignored cache-key fields in the evidence."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the second result equals the first endpoint's response, showing reuse of the cached first answer rather than a fresh second-endpoint answer."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `call_bases == [\"http://cluster-a/v1\"]`, proving only the first outbound backend call occurred."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Checks `len(dspy.cache.memory_cache) == 1`, a valid extra confirmation that only one cache entry was created."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
